changes.title: Restore the positive-rank projector hypothesis
changes.problem: The dependency summary says common finite-rank projectors but its normalized Hilbert-Schmidt overlap divides by the common rank. Rank zero makes the expression undefined.
changes.counterexample: For P_i = 0 with common rank d = 0, tr(P_i P_j) / d is 0/0.
changes.required_change: State common rank d > 0 everywhere the normalized projector Gram kernel is declared or summarized.
acceptance_evidence: Integrated theorem and claim records contain the explicit d > 0 hypothesis.
Formal Mathematics Paper 3 remains the governing proof.
A regression review confirms no summary weakens the positive-rank hypothesis.
blocked_until_closed: Integrated publication freeze for the projector theorem
Any downstream claim relying on normalized projector overlap

The overload example raw/full-scale = 1.2 produces exact score 12, displayed q10 10, overload ratio 1.2, and Q4.
